propositions: The `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` date-range flags and `--output json|text` format selection, then render the full metric registry over the specified range.

The command dispatch must route `metrics` via an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` arm in `_dispatch()` that imports and calls the entry point in `src/rebar/_commands/metrics.py`, placed on the reads path after store initialization.

The metric rendering loop must call `registry.evaluate(spec, context)` for every `MetricSpec` in `REGISTRY`, wrapping each call in try/except to render exceptions as `unavailable` rather than crashing the command.

JSON output must emit `{"since": <str>, "until": <str>, "metrics": {<id>: {lens, source, confidence, value} | {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}, ...}}` where `lens` comes from the spec and value fields from the result; text output must print one line per metric showing id, lens, source, and value-or-unavailable.

The command must import the `rebar.metrics` package (not just registry module) to hydrate `REGISTRY` via reader module side-effects in `__init__.py`, and must NOT import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module (enforced by source-level scan).

The context object passed to `evaluate()` must carry `repo_root` (resolved store root), `since`, and `until` (parsed date range), constructed as a dataclass or `SimpleNamespace` matching the contract all readers expect via `getattr(ctx, attr, None)`.
